releases.name: Superstar Strategy
releases.summary:
Outfight and outwit your enemies in this turn-based tactics game. Use each unit's unique abilities and the terrain around you to your advantage to thwart your opponent's plans and reign supreme!

Push, pull, teleport, and displace your enemies onto traps to deal additional damage and apply status effects between rounds. If you are able to escape the trap before the new round starts, you can cheat fate!

With 14 different unit roles to choose from, you can create your own unique combinations to build your own personal army! Experiment with different units to find synergies and force multipliers to improve your chances of victory.

releases.name: Criminal Hearts: Obsession Bad Boys Dating Sim
releases.summary:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three men who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what he is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls him closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and he lets something slip he's never told anyone. Push too hard and he's gone before you can fix it.

Three men. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.

releases.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
releases.summary:
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 8 players per lobby, locally or online.

The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless, unofficially dubbed as the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers’. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

releases.name: Veiled Edge
releases.summary:
A 2D action-adventure set in a stunning pixel-art cyberpunk world.

The year is 2099. The line between reality and the virtual world has disappeared.

Step into a fully immersive virtual world powered by cutting-edge Full-Dive technology. Join investigator Rapid and genius hacker Lena as they uncover the truth behind a mysterious series of incidents.

Veiled Edge is a 2D action-adventure combining fast-paced combat, detailed pixel art, and diverse gameplay styles. Master platforming and intense battles while using hacking abilities to alter the environment, reveal hidden paths, and overcome challenging stages.

Each chapter introduces unique settings and gameplay mechanics, offering fresh experiences throughout your journey. Explore cyberpunk cities, theme parks, research facilities, and more as you battle powerful enemies and bosses to expose a massive conspiracy.

Features
Beautiful pixel-art cyberpunk world
Fast-paced 2D action and platforming
Hack the environment to solve puzzles and progress
Unique gameplay in every chapter
Story-driven sci-fi mystery
Hidden routes and optional challenges to discover
